events.noteEn: One of the strongest solar flares of Solar Cycle 25, recorded by NASA GOES/DONKI.
events.noteUz: NASA GOES/DONKI qayd etgan 25-quyosh siklidagi eng kuchli quyosh chaqnashlaridan biri.

events.noteEn: Massive X9.0 solar flare with a Coronal Mass Ejection (CME).
events.noteUz: Kuchli X9.0 quyosh chaqnashi va toj massasi otilishi (CME).

events.noteEn: Fast Coronal Mass Ejection (~1,500 km/s) — high radiation risk outside Earth's magnetic field.
events.noteUz: Tez toj massasi otilishi (~1,500 km/s) — Yer magnit maydonidan tashqarida yuqori radiatsiya xavfi.

events.noteEn: Medium M-class solar flare causing elevated proton radiation levels.
events.noteUz: O'rtacha M-sinfli quyosh chaqnashi — proton radiatsiya darajasini oshiradi.
